description_en: Creates a scan task to detect sensitive data in the specified storage objects
description_zh: 调用ScanOssObjectV1接口为对应存储对象创建敏感数据识别的扫描任务
kebab_example: aliyun sddp scan-oss-object-v1 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name sddp-api-demo-bucket --object-key-list dir1/object.txt --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScanOssObjectV1

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the OSS bucket resides
parameters.help_zh: 服务地域ID，即OSS Bucket所在的地域ID
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The list of storage objects to be scanned in the OSS bucket. You can specify up to 50 object keys at a time
parameters.help_zh: 待扫描的OSS Bucket中存储对象列表，一次最多可输入50个ObjectKey
parameters.name: object_key_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the industry template.

You can call the DescribeCategoryTemplateList operation to obtain the template list. If you do not specify this parameter, the default template is used for scanning
parameters.help_zh:
行业模版ID。

可调用DescribeCategoryTemplateList获取模版列表，如不填本参数，默认使用主用模板来进行扫描
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Id.description_en: The ID of the detection task returned after the task is created
Id.description_zh: 创建识别任务成功后，返回的识别任务ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
